quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Quotes from {org}. Approve one and they'll schedule the work.
quotes.emptyHint: When {org} sends you a quote, it shows up here.
quotes.decideHint: Approve to go ahead, or decline and tell {org} why.
quotes.approveDescription: {org} will create a job for this work and contact you to schedule a visit.
quotes.declineDescription: Tell {org} why, so they can follow up or send a new quote.
quotes.approvedJob: {org} created {job} for this work and will contact you to schedule a visit.
quotes.expired: This quote has expired. Ask {org} for a new one.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyHint: When {org} sends you an invoice, it shows up here.
invoices.heading: Invoice {number}
invoices.testMode: Test mode: no real card is charged.
invoices.noOnline: Online payment isn't available. Use the details below, or contact {org}.
invoices.success: Thank you! Your payment was received.
invoices.pending: Thank you! Your payment is being confirmed. Refresh this page in a moment.
invoices.paidInFull: Paid in full on {date}. Thank you!
invoices.void: This invoice was canceled. There's nothing to pay.

errors.conflict: This changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unavailable: Online payment isn't available right now.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

checkout.title: Test checkout
checkout.notice: This page stands in for the card payment page while online payments are in test mode. It asks for no card details, and no money moves.
checkout.expired: This checkout has expired or was replaced by a newer one. Go back to the invoice to pay.

staff.linkDescription: Send this link to the customer. It pays the balance of {balance} and works until {time}.
staff.linkTest: Test mode: the link opens the test checkout, and no money moves.
staff.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy it yourself.
